name: Etsy seller fees

feeBases.listing: $0.20 USD per item sold (a multi-quantity listing is charged another $0.20 for each additional unit sold). Billed in USD and converted for sellers whose payment account is in another currency.
feeBases.transaction: 6.5% of the item price x quantity + shipping charged + gift wrap/personalisation. Sales tax collected by Etsy is not included.
feeBases.processing: Percentage of the total sale price (items + shipping + gift wrap + any sales tax Etsy collects) plus a fixed fee per order. Rate depends on the country of the seller's bank account.
feeBases.regulatory: Regulatory Operating fee in some countries, charged on item price + shipping + gift wrap/personalisation.
feeBases.offsiteAds: 15% of the order total (12% for shops with $10,000+ USD sales in any 365-day period) on orders attributed to an Etsy Offsite Ad, capped at $100 USD per order.
feeBases.currencyConversion: 2.5% of the sale amount when the listing currency is different from the payment account currency.
feeBases.vatOnFees: Many countries require Etsy to add VAT/GST to seller fees unless the seller has given Etsy a VAT ID. Rates here are the standard national rates; edit the field if yours differs.

GB.label: United Kingdom
GB.fxNote: USD-billed fees converted at about 0.72 GBP per USD (derived from GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). Edit for today's rate.

CA_DOMESTIC.label: Canada (domestic or US orders)
CA_DOMESTIC.fxNote: About 1.40 CAD per USD (GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). GST/HST on fees depends on your province and registration: enter your rate.

CA_INTERNATIONAL.label: Canada (other international orders)
CA_INTERNATIONAL.fxNote: About 1.40 CAD per USD (GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). GST/HST on fees depends on your province and registration: enter your rate.

AU_DOMESTIC.label: Australia (domestic orders)
AU_DOMESTIC.fxNote: About 1.42 AUD per USD (GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). Default GST on fees is Australia's 10% standard rate.

AU_INTERNATIONAL.label: Australia (international orders)
AU_INTERNATIONAL.fxNote: About 1.42 AUD per USD (GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). Default GST on fees is Australia's 10% standard rate.

DE.label: Germany
DE.fxNote: About 0.89 EUR per USD (GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). Default VAT on fees is Germany's 19% standard rate.

FR.label: France
FR.fxNote: About 0.89 EUR per USD (GOV.UK consular rates, November 2026). Default VAT on fees is France's 20% standard rate.

notIncluded: One-time shop setup fee charged to some new shops
Etsy Ads (on-site advertising) and Etsy Plus subscription
Shipping labels bought through Etsy (enter them as your shipping cost instead)
Fees on refunds, chargebacks and deposit/payout fees in some countries
